text:
Pierre-Luc Dubois skated on a new line with Aliaksei Protas and Ryan Leonard on Saturday and scored and set one up in Washington's 4-3 win over Florida. It was a good night in a season with a gap in it: his game log jumps from Oct. 9 to Oct. 24, and he has nine points in the ten games he has played.

The underlying numbers are strong. Washington takes 61% of the expected goals (the quality of chances) with him on at five on five, almost ten points better than without him, and Evolving-Hockey noted last season that he draws the other team's best players. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking likes how he enters the zone, carrying the puck in 71% of the time, though both of those samples are small. He isn't shooting much, two goals on 17 shots, and the Capitals have scored a bit above their chances with him on. If the new line sticks, it's the thing to watch in Washington this month.
headline: A new line, and a good night
